items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: That was my two drummers. Cozy, cold, cozy, joy, and I don't know what. ... Norm Downs and Baby Dots.

ctx.x: Yeah. Downward used to play with, what's that boy's name? I forgot his name. I forgot his name. I forgot his name. Oh, great drummer. So Baby said, say, Downward. I said, what is it, Baby? He said, I want to introduce you to a drummer. Norm Downward. I'll get to be in with an orchestra. And your uncle, you speak for that fellow. So he said, Norm, I want you to meet Downward to call that player. I don't even know him, Down's wife. He was caught when he came down. He said, yes, I mean, practice four or five hours a…
Come to find out, man. He said, Dad. I said, well, Down. I said, it's a show time. He said, is that the show?
